input.title: Women's Nana – Mom Said No? That's Cute. Crewneck Sweatshirt
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

A sly 1950s nana in cat-eye glasses and pearls slides a tall stack of chocolate chip cookies across the table with the jar lid already off, and the sweatshirt says MOM SAID NO? THAT'S CUTE. This nana sweater is for the grandmother who overrules the rules at Sunday dinners, sleepovers and Christmas morning.

The print is a 1950s storybook scene: a grandmother with curled silver hair, a pink buttoned cardigan, a pearl necklace and a flowered skirt, holding a plate of cookies stacked higher than her head, a round striped cookie jar with its lid off at her feet. MOM SAID NO? sits above in serif capitals and THAT'S CUTE. below in big coral script.

Wear it to Sunday dinner, a sleepover at Nana's or the family cookie bake, and give it to the grandmother who always says yes. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex crewneck sweatshirt fit
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband; no hood, no pockets
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 2 colors: Sand, Navy

Questions

What is the Mom Said No? That's Cute. sweatshirt?
It is a crewneck sweatshirt from Graphic Tees Co. showing a sly nana with a tower of chocolate chip cookies and an open cookie jar, lettered MOM SAID NO? THAT'S CUTE. It is a Gildan 18000 in 8 oz cotton-poly fleece, with no hood and no pockets, so it works as an easy layer.

How does the crewneck sweatshirt fit?
This Graphic Tees Co. crewneck is a classic unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL with a ribbed collar, cuffs and waistband. Order your usual size for a regular fit or size up for a roomier layer over a tee. If the size is off, the first exchange is free.

Is this a sweater, and how do I wash it?
It is a fleece crewneck sweatshirt, the kind many shoppers call a nana sweater: 50% cotton, 50% polyester at 8 oz. Wash it inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. That keeps the coral and plum inks from fading and the fleece soft after many washes.

Is it a good gift for Nana from the grandkids?
Yes. It suits the grandmother who spoils the grandkids, and it is a fun Christmas or Mother's Day gift from the kids and the daughter who said no. From Graphic Tees Co. it costs $34.99, comes in Sand and Navy, and the free size exchange makes it safe to give.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. nana sweatshirt should arrive before Christmas. Each sweatshirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.
